design.accessibility: Large fonts for readability. MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE on static labels prevents accidental input. Orientation locked to handheld. Clipboard checks ensure graceful degradation on unsupported devices. Color palette chosen for contrast.
design.direction: Visual polish for mobile: clean minimal UI with colored accent feedback, large tappable targets, consistent spacing, and subtle motion. Use theme.tres for base styling, with inline Color resources from SKINS array for interactive elements.
design.feedback: Tactile response via AudioServer (no external deps) on tap. Color flash on player landing using PULSE_V velocity. Dynamic label updates for score/share. Clipboard status shown as temporary notice text near settings.
design.layout: Responsive control scaling: UI elements positioned with percentage-based offsets relative to W/H constants. Buttons minimum 120x80px, labels sized to content. Settings area below gameplay with 82px vertical padding. Backup/restore controls in bottom bar, game over overlay centered.
design.motion: Async spawning with await get_tree().create_timer(). Platform gap variation ±120px for unpredictability. Player jump arc follows gravity simulation. Landing animation uses pulse velocity for visual bounce.
